freeze_note: config.json written BEFORE any batch10 held-out (val/test) metric was computed; immutable freeze-point for the two predeclared scientific fits (augmented Ridge and augmented HGB on raw S).

population.note: Eligible = canonical S-defined AND present in the batch03 57827-gene promoter-feature universe (has frozen composition/count features and a batch05 component split). The 178 excluded genes are S-defined in the canonical expression table but absent from the promoter-feature universe.

S_label_definition.direction: larger / less-negative S = less across-tissue dispersion
S_label_definition.not: S is NOT post-transfection temporal stability nor synthetic promoter activity
S_label_definition.reference_target: full-precision raw S (reconstructed in memory from gene_expression_table.tsv)
S_label_definition.frozen_target_only: continuous raw S only; do NOT re-run raw/rank comparison

split.name: exact/RC + detected-near-identity blocked component split (NOT homology-free)
split.note: component-level split reused exactly as frozen; retrospective not prospective; exact/RC isolation does not establish complete near-homology independence.

sequence_encoding_conventions.r400_r2000: row indices into the corresponding memmaps (verified against promoter_*_index.tsv)
sequence_encoding_conventions.gene_identity: gene_id[starts[:-1]] (first row of each gene group), NOT gene_id[g]
sequence_encoding_conventions.promoter_aggregation: normalize within each promoter first, then arithmetic mean across ALL promoters of the gene

new_feature_block.description: exactly 1024 new features concatenated to the unchanged 45-feature baseline (total 1069)
new_feature_block.tri_bin_features: 2 windows x 4 bins x 64 oriented contiguous trinucleotide frequencies
new_feature_block.tetra_features: 2 windows x 256 oriented contiguous tetranucleotide frequencies
new_feature_block.valid_start_denominator: number of wholly-valid ACGT k-mer starts inside the block/window
new_feature_block.ambiguous_handling: ambiguous bases break k-mers; no valid starts => all-zero block (frequencies 0), never NaN

transform_rules.X_scaler: sklearn StandardScaler (with_mean/with_std) fit on eligible TRAIN rows only; reused for val/test
transform_rules.target_standardization: z = (y - train_mean) / train_std (population std, ddof=0), fit on eligible TRAIN only
transform_rules.target_inverse: y_hat = z_hat * train_std + train_mean (back to raw S units)

baseline_reuse.replay: verify saved batch09 models/scaler/transforms reproduce ridge_raw/hgb_raw predictions on a deterministic small subset (no refit)

evaluation.bootstrap_unit: test components (genes within a component stay together)
evaluation.bootstrap_paired: augmented and baseline evaluated on the SAME resample; delta = aug Spearman - baseline Spearman
evaluation.interval: percentile interval [1.25, 98.75] percent => 97.5 percent two-sided per comparison
evaluation.interval_label: conservative two-comparison adjustment convention (two primary comparisons)
evaluation.acceptance_rule: scoped feature improvement requires delta >= 0.03 AND adjusted lower bound > 0
evaluation.also_report: raw-unit MAE/MSE/R2 deltas and constant baselines; R2 is calculated, never inferred from rho
evaluation.no_cross_unit_mae: MAE magnitudes never compared between raw and any other unit
evaluation.no_out_of_scope_comparison: do NOT compare these S results to batch06 E performance or a v6.3 result

resources.fits: two scientific fits (augmented Ridge + augmented HGB)
resources.no_search: no hyperparameter / architecture / threshold / target-mapping search
resources.no_validation_fit: no val/test fitting of scaler, hyperparameter, stopping rule or target mapping

scope_limits: human conditional gene-level S prediction only
not mammalian universal promoter strength / synthetic promoter activity / HEK293T construct validation / temporal stability
reused fixed test split has adaptive research exposure; repeated test use
positive result supports only this specific feature addition; negative result rejects only this tested representation/configuration
